name: tajir-ai
description: Tajir AI - AI-powered company setup platform (prototype)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace client && oxlint shared/src server/src
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && playwright test
